title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Certificate Clause on Prorated Seal-Failure Replacement
content:
This clause of Warranty Coverage concerns insulated glass claims approved with proration. Two of its sentences have been withdrawn and one remains.

## Withdrawn wording — no longer in force

The following two sentences are **no longer in force**; the current basis for prorated seal-failure shares replaces them, and they are reproduced here only so the withdrawn wording is recognised:

> For an insulated glass claim approved with proration, the customer pays the share of the published sealed-unit replacement charge that the plan's proration ladder sets for the full years since the coverage start date, times the units approved; Ridgeline pays the rest and the labor follows the labor term as for any other approval.

> The share is booked once as a prorated parts share on the decision date.

Neither the booking date nor the amount of a prorated share is taken from these withdrawn sentences.

## Wording in force

> A share of zero books nothing.

Where the prorated share of an insulated glass claim comes to zero, no prorated parts share is booked on the warranty charges.

## Figures that remain valid

The published sealed-unit replacement charge and each plan's proration ladder are unchanged figures of the plan's glass proration schedule; the withdrawal concerns the handling sentences above, not those figures.

superseded_clauses: For an insulated glass claim approved with proration, the customer pays the share of the published sealed-unit replacement charge that the plan's proration ladder sets for the full years since the coverage start date (warranty_msr_full_years), times the units approved; Ridgeline pays the rest and the labor follows the labor term as for any other approval.
The share is booked once as prorated_parts_share on the decision date.
